tasteReview.beats: Realtor.com agent-profile pages — this page wins on honesty: the 5.0 review score names its source ('SOURCE Google reviews') and exposes an expandable 'how we calculate this' methodology note, where Realtor.com/Zillow agent star ratings show a bare number with no source trace or calculation shown.
tasteReview.dullest: The Call / Text / Email / Schedule row — four generic icon-plus-label contact buttons indistinguishable from a template contact block, carrying no information and rewarding no interaction beyond firing a tel:/sms:/mailto:/calendar link.
tasteReview.verdict: This build fixes the exact defect the last review named — the review score now carries a visual proportion bar and a sourced, expandable methodology disclosure instead of being one more anonymous link row, and the row count is short enough that it no longer reads as the banned scrolling-list tell. But the fold is still four sparse rows on mostly empty cream: one small headshot thumbnail is the only image, there's no map, no Bend context, nothing a stranger would screenshot to show a friend. Ship the honesty fix as a genuine improvement, then come back for the composition — an About page for a boutique brokerage should feel inhabited, not administered.

defects.finding: The entire visible fold is a hero line plus three low-height information rows on otherwise empty cream — no photograph beyond a small headshot thumbnail, no map graphic, no texture — so an About page reads as a compact administrative contact card rather than an inhabited brand moment.
defects.fix: Add one real visual anchor to the fold — an office/team photo, a static map thumbnail for 'The office' row, or a Bend-context image — so the page carries brand warmth, not just text rows.

defects.finding: All four actions fire an external protocol (tel:/sms:/mailto:/calendar) immediately; none rewards a tap or hover with more information first — the row's only function is leaving the page, same complaint as the prior mark's link menu.
defects.fix: Give at least one action (e.g. Schedule) an inline expansion — available times, response-time note — before it hands off to another app or page.

defects.finding: At 375px the fold ends with 'SOURCE Google reviews' flush to the bottom edge with no partial reveal of, or cue toward, further content below — a visitor scanning quickly reads the fold as the complete, finished page.
defects.fix: Let the next section's edge (a photo strip, a heading) peek into the last 40-60px of the viewport, or add a visible scroll affordance.

defects.section: broker row / contact row / reviews-office row
defects.finding: The three information rows below the hero share one left-label/right-value hairline shape; varied in content but not in structure, so the section still reads primarily as a form being filled in rather than an edited page.
defects.fix: Give one row a genuinely different shape — e.g. render 'The office' as a small map graphic instead of an address line — so the rhythm isn't three repeats of the same row template.
